title: Slugify: Small String, Big Details
description: A seven-part tour of Sindre Sorhus's slugify library: how it turns any text into clean, URL-safe slugs, and the surprising edge cases hidden in roughly one hundred sixty lines of JavaScript.

episodes.summary: What slugify does, who it is for, and why naive slug generation breaks on real-world text.
